facts.fact: Vodacom CEO Shameel Joosub told TechCentral that Vodafone Egypt plans a sovereign AI data centre with Elsewedy Electric and Cassava Technologies, costing about US$1bn over the next couple of years and built in modules, with Vodafone Egypt owning about 30%.
